339-677-6791-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-6791-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

401-3944-7492-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-3944-7492-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life
Repeat.

2105-5778-6965-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2034-7084-7893.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2073-5147-6808-7878.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 12 or less.
2073-5147-6808-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When The Last Ride enters, Kolodin triggers, causing The Last Ride to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing The Last Ride.
When The Last Ride dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2122-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Mindless Automaton.
When Mindless Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1363-1636-2459.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast Rograkh.
You control at least one additional creature,
1363-1636-2459.description:
Cast Rograkh by paying its mana cost.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Rograkh and one other creature you control, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1363-1636-2459.notes: If you control creature(s) that can tap to produce mana, you can use that mana to pay for the creature and instead gain mana from the creature's ETB ability.

1558-5471-7348.notablePrerequisites: Obeka has power 7 or greater and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1558-5471-7348.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Replicating Ring triggers, putting a night counter on it. Then, if it has eight or more night counters, remove all of them and create eight Replicating Ring tokens.
Deal combat damage using Obeka. Obeka triggers, causing you to get at least seven upkeep steps after this phase.
Repeat step 1 for each of the additional upkeep steps.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Replicating Ring tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2079-3259-4689.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3259-4689.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Otharri as attackers.
Otharri triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1003-2173-4659-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1462-4863-6801.easyPrerequisites:
You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
Permanents you control that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {1}{W}{W}.
1462-4863-6801.description:
Activate any number of permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}{W}.
Cast Cleansing Meditation by paying {1}{W}{W}, destroying all permanents as they are all enchantments due to Enchanted Evening, and then returning all cards in your graveyard destroyed this way to the battlefield.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cleansing Meditation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1462-4863-6801.notes: You can repeat this combo as desired during your turns to continually wipe out opponents' permanents.

662-4222-6784.easyPrerequisites: Steelswarm Operator does not have summoning sickness.
662-4222-6784.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Freed from the Real to become an artifact.
Activate Steelswarm Operator's second ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Steelswarm Operator.
Repeat from step 2.
662-4222-6784.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Steelswarm Operator's first ability instead.

3799-6758.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn.
3799-6758.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
3799-6758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, dealing 100 damage to  Stuffy Doll.
Stuffy Doll triggers, dealing 100 damage to the named player.

152-1418-2034-5446.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariot token enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers twice, creating four 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Cats, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
152-1418-2034-5446.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Cats and/or target any other artifact using Cogwork Assembler.

880-3678-6664.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-3678-6664.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1339-2034-2122-4565.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2034-2122-4565.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

800-4116-4188.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 4 life this turn.
800-4116-4188.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Accomplished Alchemist.
Activate Volrath by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Knacksaw Clique.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}{U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of an opponent's library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Repeat.

4446-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Cleric
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
4446-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2091-2239-2921-4558.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least nine tapped lands.
2091-2239-2921-4558.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Ardent Elementalist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Ardent Elementalist by paying its mana cost.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ardent Elementalist.
Repeat.

2773-2921-4133.description:
Cast Soul Collector by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Soul Collector enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, causing Soul Collector to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
If an ability from Bartolomé del Presidio is waiting to resolve, let it resolve.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Soul Collector.
When Soul Collector dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

751-3484-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least {E} or enough mana to cast Shrieking Drake
751-3484-5674.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers, if able, or by paying its mana cost.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it and Decoction Module trigger.
Resolve the Decoction Module trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1992-4419-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
1992-4419-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
Basri's Lieutenant trigger, creating a 2/2 Knight token.
When Knight token enters the battlefield, Renata trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Knight token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability by dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

386-1525-2396-4298.notablePrerequisites:
Glistening Oil and Ophidian Eye attached to Borborygmos.
You have a land card in hand.
You have at least eleven lands between your hand and library.
386-1525-2396-4298.description:
Activate Borborygmos by discarding a land, dealing three infect damage to an opponent.
Ophidian Eye triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.

618-4846.description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon by paying {3}{R}{R}{R}.
Worldgorger Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
The token Worldgorger Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling all other permanents you control.
The nontoken Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning nothing from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Worldgorger Dragon trigger from step 2, exiling the token Worldgorger Dragon.
The token Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning all permanents exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
